name: ralph-loop
description: Continuous self-referential AI loops for interactive iterative development, implementing the Ralph Wiggum technique. Run Claude in a while-true loop with the same prompt until task completion. Fork of the Anthropic plugin: fail-closed transcript extraction, a stop hook whose output is not mistakable for the model's own completion promise, an `active` field that actually pauses the loop, and a pause that announces itself instead of ending the run in silence.
